notes: Item 19 reports net sales for EPL Restaurants (franchised + franchisor-owned) for fiscal year 2024 (Dec 28, 2023 – Dec 25, 2024). Data is segmented by three building categories: (A) with Drive-Thru, (B) without Drive-Thru, (C) All EPL Restaurants. Within each category, outlets are further split into four performance tiers (Top 25%, Mid-high 51-75%, Mid-low 26-50%, Lowest 25%) and a Total All Restaurants row. Each tier provides average, median, count, and count-over-average. The Total row also provides max and min. Franchised, Franchisor, and Total EPL columns are calculated independently, so totals may not sum. All values are annual net sales.
